name: Chatterbox Multilingual V3
purpose: General-purpose multilingual TTS and voice cloning in 23+ languages with better speaker similarity and fewer hallucinations than V2; production-grade open source, with emotion exaggeration control and watermarked output (card).

license.name: MIT
license.notes: LICENSE in https://github.com/resemble-ai/chatterbox read: MIT License, Copyright (c) 2025 Resemble AI. Every output carries a PerTh neural watermark (card); do not strip it where the license of use requires labelling.

architecture.kind: AUTOREGRESSIVE 0.5B Llama backbone over speech tokens (card: "0.5B Llama backbone")
architecture.why_this_design: Card: same 0.5B size as V2 with improved training for speaker similarity and stability; Single Language Pack gives per-language finetunes for tighter quality control.

engine_support.notes: Llama backbone: a Tona dense-transformer path could serve the speech-token LM; codec stays external.

weaknesses: no independent German quality numbers found

tona_fit.reason: MIT, 0.5B, German in 23 languages, a Llama-class AR backbone that a Tona dense path could run; fits every class. No German numbers anywhere, so quality is unproven. Low priority for coding agents.
